+"""Per-provider endpoint policy on the cheval Python path (cycle-129 FR-7, SDD D-7.2, D-8.0).
+
+The rule, applied at config load to every HTTP provider in the merged ``hounfour.providers`` view:
+
+* ``allow_insecure_endpoint`` is a host STRING, never a boolean. It must be an IP literal or ``localhost``
+  (an insecure endpoint is never resolved through DNS, so there is no rebinding), and the address must be
+  loopback (``127.0.0.0/8``, ``::1``) or RFC1918 (``10/8``, ``172.16/12``, ``192.168/16``). Link-local,
+  the cloud metadata addresses, unique-local IPv6 and every public range are refused.
+* An ``http://`` endpoint is admitted only when its host equals the provider's opt-in host. A mismatched
+  host, a public ``http`` host or an ``http`` endpoint without an opt-in fails at load with a named reason.
+* Every other endpoint keeps the cycle-099 refusals: ``https`` only, no userinfo, no control bytes or path
+  traversal, and no loopback, private, link-local, metadata or otherwise blocked IP literal (``localhost``
+  included). One provider's opt-in never changes another provider's checks.
+* ``keyless: true`` marks a provider that needs no credential; a literal ``auth: "local"`` is accepted and
+  normalised to ``keyless: true`` in the merged view. A keyless provider is admitted only when every model
+  declares ``context_window`` and ``dispatch_group``.
+
+ONE implementation: every URL and opt-in decision here is made by the canonical
+``.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py`` (the module the bash callers and the health probe use),
+loaded by path as ``loa_cheval.codegen.emit_endpoint_validator_ts`` does: ``check_insecure_optin`` for the
+opt-in and ``validate_declared_endpoint`` (the full pipeline minus the host allowlist, which an
+operator-declared https host is not on) for the endpoint. The refusal codes are therefore the validator's
+codes, and URL parsing stays confined to that module (the cycle-099 import guard).
+``tests/test_endpoint_validator_optin.py`` runs one case table through both entry points.
+
+Request-time half (``TransportPolicy`` in ``providers/base.py``): for an opted-in provider, or a model whose
+``dispatch_group`` is ``local``, the adapter ignores proxy environment variables, refuses HTTP redirects and
+requires every request URL to stay under the declared endpoint path.
+
+CLI (used by ``model-health-probe.sh --provider <name>``; reads the merged config, never prints a secret)::
+
+    python3 -m loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy list-providers [--project-root DIR]
+    python3 -m loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy describe-provider NAME [--project-root DIR]
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+from loa_cheval.types import ConfigError
+
+# The literal auth values normalised to keyless (D-8.0). Only "local": any other literal could be a real key.
+KEYLESS_AUTH_LITERALS = frozenset({"local"})
+
+# .claude/adapters/loa_cheval/config/endpoint_policy.py → .claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py
+_VALIDATOR_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "scripts" / "lib" / "endpoint-validator.py"
+_VALIDATOR: Any = None
+_VALIDATOR_LOCK = threading.Lock()
+
+
+def _validator() -> Any:
+    """The canonical endpoint-validator module, loaded once by path. A missing
+    or unloadable validator is a ConfigError (fail-closed: no endpoint is
+    admitted unchecked)."""
+    global _VALIDATOR
+    with _VALIDATOR_LOCK:
+        if _VALIDATOR is not None:
+            return _VALIDATOR
+        name = "loa_endpoint_validator_canonical"
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, _VALIDATOR_PATH)
+        if spec is None or spec.loader is None or not _VALIDATOR_PATH.is_file():
+            raise ConfigError(f"[ENDPOINT-VALIDATOR-MISSING] {_VALIDATOR_PATH} not found; reinstall the framework")
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        try:
+            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — any load failure is fail-closed
+            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
+            raise ConfigError(f"[ENDPOINT-VALIDATOR-MISSING] {_VALIDATOR_PATH} failed to load: {exc}") from exc
+        _VALIDATOR = module
+        return module
+
+
+class EndpointPolicyError(ConfigError):
+    """A provider endpoint or opt-in refused at load. ``policy_code`` is the endpoint-validator code."""
+
+    def __init__(self, code: str, detail: str, provider: Optional[str] = None):
+        where = f"providers.{provider}: " if provider else ""
+        super().__init__(f"[{code}] {where}{detail}", context={"policy_code": code, "provider": provider})
+        self.policy_code = code
+        self.detail = detail
+
+
+def split_url(url: str) -> Tuple[str, str, Optional[int], str]:
+    """(scheme, canonical host, explicit port or None, path) via the canonical validator; ValueError on a bad URL."""
+    return _validator().split_url(url)
+
+
+def canonical_optin_host(value: Any, provider: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    """Validate an ``allow_insecure_endpoint`` value and return its canonical host, or raise."""
+    ok, code, detail, host = _validator().check_insecure_optin(value)
+    if not ok:
+        raise EndpointPolicyError(code or "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-INVALID", detail or "invalid opt-in", provider)
+    return host
+
+
+def check_endpoint(endpoint: str, allow_insecure_endpoint: Any = None, provider: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Apply the D-7.2 rule to one provider's endpoint. Returns the canonical opt-in host (or None); raises."""
+    optin = canonical_optin_host(allow_insecure_endpoint, provider) if allow_insecure_endpoint is not None else None
+    result = _validator().validate_declared_endpoint(endpoint, allow_insecure_endpoint=optin)
+    if not result.valid:
+        raise EndpointPolicyError(result.code or "ENDPOINT-INVALID", result.detail or "endpoint refused", provider)
+    return optin
+
+
+# --- the merged view --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _is_cli_provider(prov: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    ptype = str(prov.get("type") or "")
+    if ptype.endswith("-headless"):
+        return True
+    models = prov.get("models") or {}
+    return bool(models) and isinstance(models, dict) and all(
+        isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("kind") == "cli" for m in models.values()
+    )
+
+
+def normalise_keyless(merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Pre-interpolation step: a literal ``auth: "local"`` becomes ``keyless: true`` (D-8.0); ``keyless`` must be a bool."""
+    providers = merged.get("providers")
+    if not isinstance(providers, dict):
+        return
+    for name, prov in providers.items():
+        if not isinstance(prov, dict):
+            continue
+        if "keyless" in prov and not isinstance(prov["keyless"], bool):
+            raise ConfigError(
+                f"[CONFIG-INVALID] providers.{name}.keyless must be true or false, got {prov['keyless']!r}"
+            )
+        auth = prov.get("auth")
+        if isinstance(auth, str) and auth.strip().lower() in KEYLESS_AUTH_LITERALS:
+            prov["keyless"] = True
+
+
+def validate_providers(merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Post-interpolation step: endpoint rule and keyless preconditions for every provider."""
+    providers = merged.get("providers")
+    if not isinstance(providers, dict):
+        return
+    for name, prov in providers.items():
+        if not isinstance(prov, dict):
+            continue
+        optin = prov.get("allow_insecure_endpoint")
+        endpoint = prov.get("endpoint")
+        if not _is_cli_provider(prov) and endpoint not in (None, ""):
+            if not isinstance(endpoint, str):
+                raise ConfigError(f"[CONFIG-INVALID] providers.{name}.endpoint must be a string")
+            check_endpoint(endpoint, optin, name)
+        elif optin is not None:
+            # An opt-in with nothing to apply to is still validated, so a typo never sits silent.
+            canonical_optin_host(optin, name)
+        if prov.get("keyless") is True:
+            models = prov.get("models") or {}
+            if not isinstance(models, dict) or not models:
+                raise ConfigError(f"[CONFIG-INVALID] providers.{name} is keyless but declares no models")

+"""Per-provider endpoint policy on the cheval Python path (cycle-129 FR-7, SDD D-7.2, D-8.0).
+
+The rule, applied at config load to every HTTP provider in the merged ``hounfour.providers`` view:
+
+* ``allow_insecure_endpoint`` is a host STRING, never a boolean. It must be an IP literal or ``localhost``
+  (an insecure endpoint is never resolved through DNS, so there is no rebinding), and the address must be
+  loopback (``127.0.0.0/8``, ``::1``) or RFC1918 (``10/8``, ``172.16/12``, ``192.168/16``). Link-local,
+  the cloud metadata addresses, unique-local IPv6 and every public range are refused.
+* An ``http://`` endpoint is admitted only when its host equals the provider's opt-in host. A mismatched
+  host, a public ``http`` host or an ``http`` endpoint without an opt-in fails at load with a named reason.
+* Every other endpoint keeps the cycle-099 refusals: ``https`` only, no userinfo, no control bytes or path
+  traversal, and no loopback, private, link-local, metadata or otherwise blocked IP literal (``localhost``
+  included). One provider's opt-in never changes another provider's checks.
+* ``keyless: true`` marks a provider that needs no credential; a literal ``auth: "local"`` is accepted and
+  normalised to ``keyless: true`` in the merged view. A keyless provider is admitted only when every model
+  declares ``context_window`` and ``dispatch_group``.
+
+ONE implementation: every URL and opt-in decision here is made by the canonical
+``.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py`` (the module the bash callers and the health probe use),
+loaded by path as ``loa_cheval.codegen.emit_endpoint_validator_ts`` does: ``check_insecure_optin`` for the
+opt-in and ``validate_declared_endpoint`` (the full pipeline minus the host allowlist, which an
+operator-declared https host is not on) for the endpoint. The refusal codes are therefore the validator's
+codes, and URL parsing stays confined to that module (the cycle-099 import guard).
+``tests/test_endpoint_validator_optin.py`` runs one case table through both entry points.
+
+Request-time half (``TransportPolicy`` in ``providers/base.py``): for an opted-in provider, or a model whose
+``dispatch_group`` is ``local``, the adapter ignores proxy environment variables, refuses HTTP redirects and
+requires every request URL to stay under the declared endpoint path.
+
+CLI (used by ``model-health-probe.sh --provider <name>``; reads the merged config, never prints a secret)::
+
+    python3 -m loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy list-providers [--project-root DIR]
+    python3 -m loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy describe-provider NAME [--project-root DIR]
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import re
+import sys
+import threading
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+from loa_cheval.types import ConfigError
+
+# The literal auth values normalised to keyless (D-8.0). Only "local": any other literal could be a real key.
+KEYLESS_AUTH_LITERALS = frozenset({"local"})
+
+# .claude/adapters/loa_cheval/config/endpoint_policy.py → .claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py
+_VALIDATOR_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "scripts" / "lib" / "endpoint-validator.py"
+_VALIDATOR: Any = None
+_VALIDATOR_LOCK = threading.Lock()
+
+
+def _validator() -> Any:
+    """The canonical endpoint-validator module, loaded once by path. A missing
+    or unloadable validator is a ConfigError (fail-closed: no endpoint is
+    admitted unchecked)."""
+    global _VALIDATOR
+    with _VALIDATOR_LOCK:
+        if _VALIDATOR is not None:
+            return _VALIDATOR
+        name = "loa_endpoint_validator_canonical"
+        spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, _VALIDATOR_PATH)
+        if spec is None or spec.loader is None or not _VALIDATOR_PATH.is_file():
+            raise ConfigError(f"[ENDPOINT-VALIDATOR-MISSING] {_VALIDATOR_PATH} not found; reinstall the framework")
+        module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+        sys.modules[name] = module
+        try:
+            spec.loader.exec_module(module)
+        except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — any load failure is fail-closed
+            sys.modules.pop(name, None)
+            raise ConfigError(f"[ENDPOINT-VALIDATOR-MISSING] {_VALIDATOR_PATH} failed to load: {exc}") from exc
+        _VALIDATOR = module
+        return module
+
+
+class EndpointPolicyError(ConfigError):
+    """A provider endpoint or opt-in refused at load. ``policy_code`` is the endpoint-validator code."""
+
+    def __init__(self, code: str, detail: str, provider: Optional[str] = None):
+        where = f"providers.{provider}: " if provider else ""
+        super().__init__(f"[{code}] {where}{detail}", context={"policy_code": code, "provider": provider})
+        self.policy_code = code
+        self.detail = detail
+
+
+def split_url(url: str) -> Tuple[str, str, Optional[int], str]:
+    """(scheme, canonical host, explicit port or None, path) via the canonical validator; ValueError on a bad URL."""
+    return _validator().split_url(url)
+
+
+def canonical_optin_host(value: Any, provider: Optional[str] = None) -> str:
+    """Validate an ``allow_insecure_endpoint`` value and return its canonical host, or raise."""
+    ok, code, detail, host = _validator().check_insecure_optin(value)
+    if not ok:
+        raise EndpointPolicyError(code or "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-INVALID", detail or "invalid opt-in", provider)
+    return host
+
+
+def check_endpoint(endpoint: str, allow_insecure_endpoint: Any = None, provider: Optional[str] = None) -> Optional[str]:
+    """Apply the D-7.2 rule to one provider's endpoint. Returns the canonical opt-in host (or None); raises."""
+    optin = canonical_optin_host(allow_insecure_endpoint, provider) if allow_insecure_endpoint is not None else None
+    result = _validator().validate_declared_endpoint(endpoint, allow_insecure_endpoint=optin)
+    if not result.valid:
+        raise EndpointPolicyError(result.code or "ENDPOINT-INVALID", result.detail or "endpoint refused", provider)
+    return optin
+
+
+# --- the merged view --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _is_cli_provider(prov: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+    ptype = str(prov.get("type") or "")
+    if ptype.endswith("-headless"):
+        return True
+    models = prov.get("models") or {}
+    return bool(models) and isinstance(models, dict) and all(
+        isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("kind") == "cli" for m in models.values()
+    )
+
+
+def normalise_keyless(merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Pre-interpolation step: a literal ``auth: "local"`` becomes ``keyless: true`` (D-8.0); ``keyless`` must be a bool."""
+    providers = merged.get("providers")
+    if not isinstance(providers, dict):
+        return
+    for name, prov in providers.items():
+        if not isinstance(prov, dict):
+            continue
+        if "keyless" in prov and not isinstance(prov["keyless"], bool):
+            raise ConfigError(
+                f"[CONFIG-INVALID] providers.{name}.keyless must be true or false, got {prov['keyless']!r}"
+            )
+        auth = prov.get("auth")
+        if isinstance(auth, str) and auth.strip().lower() in KEYLESS_AUTH_LITERALS:
+            prov["keyless"] = True
+
+
+def validate_providers(merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    """Post-interpolation step: endpoint rule and keyless preconditions for every provider."""
+    providers = merged.get("providers")
+    if not isinstance(providers, dict):
+        return
+    for name, prov in providers.items():
+        if not isinstance(prov, dict):
+            continue
+        optin = prov.get("allow_insecure_endpoint")
+        endpoint = prov.get("endpoint")
+        if not _is_cli_provider(prov) and endpoint not in (None, ""):
+            if not isinstance(endpoint, str):
+                raise ConfigError(f"[CONFIG-INVALID] providers.{name}.endpoint must be a string")
+            check_endpoint(endpoint, optin, name)
+        elif optin is not None:
+            # An opt-in with nothing to apply to is still validated, so a typo never sits silent.
+            canonical_optin_host(optin, name)
+        if prov.get("keyless") is True:
+            models = prov.get("models") or {}
+            if not isinstance(models, dict) or not models:
+                raise ConfigError(f"[CONFIG-INVALID] providers.{name} is keyless but declares no models")

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 (SDD D-7.2; sprint-257 Task 3.1, AC-3.1) — the per-provider
+insecure-endpoint opt-in on BOTH paths, and the request-time rules.
+
+* One case table runs through the bash-path validator
+  (`.claude/scripts/lib/endpoint-validator.py` `validate(..., allow_insecure_endpoint=...)`)
+  and the cheval Python path (`loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy.check_endpoint`); the two
+  must agree on accept/refuse and on the refusal code.
+* D-7.2 test list: IPv4 and IPv6 loopback accepted, RFC1918 accepted, link-local and metadata
+  refused, DNS name refused, boolean refused, cross-provider isolation, and — at request time
+  against a stub server bound to 127.0.0.1 — redirect refused, proxy env ignored, path prefix
+  enforced, on the httpx and the urllib transport.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import importlib.util
+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import threading
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+
+import pytest
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from loa_cheval.config.endpoint_policy import EndpointPolicyError, check_endpoint  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers import base  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers.base import TransportPolicy, http_get, http_post, http_post_stream  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.types import InvalidConfigError  # noqa: E402
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+VALIDATOR_PATH = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "scripts" / "lib" / "endpoint-validator.py"
+ALLOWLIST_PATH = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "scripts" / "lib" / "allowlists" / "loa-providers.json"
+
+
+def _load_validator():
+    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("endpoint_validator_under_test", VALIDATOR_PATH)
+    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
+    assert spec.loader is not None
+    sys.modules[spec.name] = mod
+    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
+    return mod
+
+
+EV = _load_validator()
+ALLOWLIST = EV.load_allowlist(ALLOWLIST_PATH)
+
+OK = None
+# (case id, url, allow_insecure_endpoint, expected refusal code or OK)
+CASES = [
+    ("ipv4-loopback", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1", OK),
+    ("ipv4-loopback-other-127", "http://127.0.0.2:8000/v1", "127.0.0.2", OK),
+    ("ipv6-loopback", "http://[::1]:8000/v1", "::1", OK),
+    ("ipv6-loopback-bracketed-optin", "http://[::1]:8000/v1", "[::1]", OK),
+    ("localhost", "http://localhost:11434/v1", "localhost", OK),
+    ("rfc1918-10", "http://10.0.0.7:8000/v1", "10.0.0.7", OK),
+    ("rfc1918-172-16", "http://172.16.5.5:8000/v1", "172.16.5.5", OK),
+    ("rfc1918-192-168", "http://192.168.0.10:8000/v1", "192.168.0.10", OK),
+    ("https-to-optin-host", "https://192.168.0.10/v1", "192.168.0.10", OK),
+    ("link-local-v4", "http://169.254.7.7/v1", "169.254.7.7", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-LINK-LOCAL"),
+    ("link-local-v6", "http://[fe80::1]/v1", "fe80::1", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-LINK-LOCAL"),
+    ("metadata-v4", "http://169.254.169.254/latest", "169.254.169.254", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-METADATA"),
+    ("metadata-v6", "http://[fd00:ec2::254]/latest", "fd00:ec2::254", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-METADATA"),
+    ("dns-name", "http://llm.lan:8000/v1", "llm.lan", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME"),
+    ("public-v4", "http://8.8.8.8/v1", "8.8.8.8", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-NOT-LOCAL"),
+    ("ipv6-unique-local", "http://[fd12:3456::1]/v1", "fd12:3456::1", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-NOT-LOCAL"),
+    ("cgnat-not-rfc1918", "http://100.64.0.1/v1", "100.64.0.1", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-NOT-LOCAL"),
+    ("boolean-true", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", True, "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-BOOLEAN"),
+    ("boolean-false", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", False, "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-BOOLEAN"),
+    ("optin-with-port", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1:8000", "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME"),

+    ("http-no-optin-loopback", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),
+    ("http-no-optin-public", "http://8.8.8.8/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"),
+    ("https-no-optin-loopback", "https://127.0.0.1/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-rfc1918", "https://10.0.0.1/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-metadata", "https://169.254.169.254/", None, "ENDPOINT-IP-BLOCKED"),
+    ("https-no-optin-v6-loopback", "https://[::1]/v1", None, "ENDPOINT-IPV6-BLOCKED"),
+    ("userinfo-on-optin-host", "http://user:pw@127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1", "ENDPOINT-USERINFO-PRESENT"),

+
+
+def _cheval(url: str, optin: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    try:
+        check_endpoint(url, optin, "p")
+    except EndpointPolicyError as exc:
+        return exc.policy_code
+    return OK
+
+
+def _bash_path(url: str, optin: Any) -> Optional[str]:
+    result = EV.validate(url, ALLOWLIST, allow_insecure_endpoint=optin)
+    return OK if result.valid else result.code
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("case, url, optin, expected", CASES, ids=[c[0] for c in CASES])
+def test_both_paths_agree(case, url, optin, expected):
+    assert _cheval(url, optin) == expected, f"cheval path: {case}"
+    assert _bash_path(url, optin) == expected, f"endpoint-validator.py: {case}"
+
+
+def test_validator_cli_flag_admits_only_the_optin_host():
+    def run(*args: str) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
+        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", str(VALIDATOR_PATH), "--allowlist", str(ALLOWLIST_PATH), *args],
+                              capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
+
+    ok = run("--allow-insecure-endpoint", "127.0.0.1", "--json", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert ok.returncode == 0, ok.stderr
+    assert json.loads(ok.stdout)["extra"] == {"insecure_optin": "127.0.0.1"}
+    refused = run("--allow-insecure-endpoint", "true", "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert refused.returncode == 78 and "ENDPOINT-OPTIN-DNS-NAME" in refused.stderr
+    no_optin = run("http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/models")
+    assert no_optin.returncode == 78 and "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME" in no_optin.stderr
+
+
+def test_cross_provider_isolation_on_both_paths():
+    """Provider A's opt-in is passed with A's URL only; provider B (same loopback host, no
+    opt-in of its own) keeps every refusal on both paths, before and after A is validated."""
+    a_url, a_optin = "http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", "127.0.0.1"
+    b_url = "http://127.0.0.1:9000/v1"
+    for _ in range(2):
+        assert _cheval(a_url, a_optin) is OK and _bash_path(a_url, a_optin) is OK
+        assert _cheval(b_url, None) == "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"
+        assert _bash_path(b_url, None) == "ENDPOINT-INSECURE-SCHEME"
+    # the hosted provider's https URL is untouched by A's opt-in
+    assert _bash_path("https://api.openai.com/v1", None) is OK
+    assert _bash_path("https://api.openai.com/v1", a_optin) is OK
+
+
+# --- request time: a stub server on 127.0.0.1 -------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Stub:
+    """127.0.0.1 HTTP server the test starts and stops. Paths: /v1/ok (200 JSON),
+    /v1/redirect (302 to /v1/ok), /v1/stream (one SSE chunk). Records request headers."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        stub = self
+        self.seen: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+        class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            def _reply(self) -> None:
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
+                if length:
+                    self.rfile.read(length)
+                stub.seen.append({"path": self.path, "headers": dict(self.headers)})
+                if self.path.endswith("/redirect"):
+                    self.send_response(302)
+                    self.send_header("Location", f"http://127.0.0.1:{stub.port}/v1/ok")
+                    self.send_header("Content-Length", "0")
+                    self.end_headers()
+                    return
+                payload = b'{"ok": true}'
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(payload)
+
+            do_GET = _reply
+            do_POST = _reply
+
+            def log_message(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+                pass
+
+        self.server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+        self.port = self.server.server_port
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+
+    def __enter__(self) -> "_Stub":
+        self.thread.start()
+        return self
+
+    def __exit__(self, *exc: Any) -> None:
+        self.server.shutdown()
+        self.server.server_close()
+
+    @property
+    def endpoint(self) -> str:
+        return f"http://127.0.0.1:{self.port}/v1"
+
+

+def transport(request, monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(base, "_HTTP_CLIENT", request.param)
+    yield request.param
+    base._reset_http_client_detection_for_tests()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def stub():
+    with _Stub() as s:
+        yield s
+
+
+def _policy(s: _Stub) -> TransportPolicy:
+    return TransportPolicy(endpoint=s.endpoint, provider="local")
+
+
+def test_redirect_refused(transport, stub):
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        http_post(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        http_get(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, policy=_policy(stub))
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidConfigError, match="redirect refused"):
+        with http_post_stream(f"{stub.endpoint}/redirect", {}, {"x": 1}, policy=_policy(stub)):
+            pass

+    assert all(r["path"].endswith("/redirect") for r in stub.seen)

+    # was built; drop it so the no-policy control below sees this test's proxy env.

+

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 (SDD D-7.3, §6; sprint-257 Task 3.2, AC-3.2) — structured output on
+the OpenAI chat-completions path.
+
+* `_build_chat_body` carries `response_format: {type: json_schema, json_schema: {name,
+  schema, strict: true}}` when the request has an output schema AND the model entry
+  declares `structured_json`; absent otherwise.
+* `schema_enforced` in the result metadata is True only when the body sent carried it.
+* An HTTP 400 whose body names `response_format`/`json_schema` is retried once without
+  the schema and recorded (`schema_enforced: False`, `schema_rejected_by_server: True`);
+  any other 400 is not retried. Streaming and non-streaming transports both.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import sys
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List
+
+import pytest
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from loa_cheval.providers import openai_adapter as oa  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers.openai_adapter import OpenAIAdapter  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.types import CompletionRequest, InvalidInputError, ModelConfig, ProviderConfig  # noqa: E402
+
+SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"findings": {"type": "array"}}, "required": ["findings"],
+          "additionalProperties": False}
+
+
+def _cfg(caps: List[str]) -> ProviderConfig:
+    return ProviderConfig(
+        name="local", type="openai_compat", endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", auth="", keyless=True,
+        allow_insecure_endpoint="127.0.0.1",
+        models={"m": ModelConfig(capabilities=caps, context_window=32768, endpoint_family="chat",
+                                 dispatch_group="local")},
+    )
+
+
+def _req(schema: Any = SCHEMA) -> CompletionRequest:
+    meta = {"output_schema_name": "adversarial-finding.wire.json"} if schema is not None else {}
+    return CompletionRequest(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "review"}], model="m", max_tokens=64,
+                             output_schema=schema, metadata=meta)
+
+
+# --- body ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def test_chat_body_carries_response_format_for_a_structured_json_entry():
+    adapter = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"]))
+    body = adapter._build_chat_body(_req(), adapter._get_model_config("m"))
+    assert body["response_format"] == {
+        "type": "json_schema",
+        "json_schema": {"name": "adversarial-finding", "schema": SCHEMA, "strict": True},
+    }
+    assert oa._schema_enforced(body) is True
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("caps, schema", [(["chat"], SCHEMA), (["chat", "structured_json"], None)],
+                         ids=["no-structured_json-capability", "no-schema-requested"])
+def test_chat_body_has_no_response_format_otherwise(caps, schema):
+    adapter = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(caps))
+    body = adapter._build_chat_body(_req(schema), adapter._get_model_config("m"))
+    assert "response_format" not in body
+    assert oa._schema_enforced(body) is False
+
+
+# --- schema_enforced truth through complete() -----------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _ok_chat() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"choices": [{"message": {"content": '{"findings": []}'}}], "model": "m",
+            "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 3, "completion_tokens": 4}}
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("caps, expected", [(["chat", "structured_json"], True), (["chat"], False)])
+def test_schema_enforced_is_true_only_when_the_body_carried_it(monkeypatch, caps, expected):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 200, _ok_chat()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(caps)).complete(_req())
+    assert ("response_format" in sent[0]) is expected
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is expected
+    assert "schema_rejected_by_server" not in result.metadata
+
+
+# --- the 400 retry ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+_REJECTIONS = [
+    {"error": {"message": "response_format json_schema is not supported by this server", "type": "BadRequestError"}},
+    {"object": "error", "message": "Unknown field: json_schema", "code": 400},
+    {"detail": [{"loc": ["body", "response_format"], "msg": "extra fields not permitted"}]},
+]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("rejection", _REJECTIONS, ids=["openai-shape", "vllm-shape", "fastapi-shape"])
+def test_non_streaming_400_naming_response_format_retries_once_without_it(monkeypatch, rejection):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    replies = [(400, rejection), (200, _ok_chat())]
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(dict(body))
+        return replies.pop(0)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2
+    assert "response_format" in sent[0] and "response_format" not in sent[1]
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is False
+    assert result.metadata["schema_rejected_by_server"] is True
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+
+
+def test_a_400_not_naming_response_format_is_not_retried(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 400, {"error": {"message": "max_tokens is too large"}}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidInputError, match="max_tokens is too large"):
+        OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 1
+
+
+def test_a_second_rejection_is_not_retried_again(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+    def fake_post(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(body)
+        return 400, {"error": {"message": "response_format unsupported"}}
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", fake_post)
+    with pytest.raises(InvalidInputError):
+        OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2   # the original and exactly one retry without the schema
+
+
+class _FakeStream:
+    def __init__(self, status: int, chunks: List[bytes]):
+        self.status_code = status
+        self._chunks = chunks
+
+    def iter_bytes(self):
+        return iter(self._chunks)
+
+
+def test_streaming_400_naming_response_format_retries_once_without_it(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", raising=False)
+    sent: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+    ok_sse = [
+        b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"content":"{\\"findings\\": []}"},"finish_reason":null}],"model":"m"}\n\n',
+        b'data: {"choices":[{"delta":{},"finish_reason":"stop"}],"model":"m"}\n\n',
+        b"data: [DONE]\n\n",
+    ]
+    replies = [_FakeStream(400, [b'{"error":{"message":"response_format is not supported"}}']),
+               _FakeStream(200, ok_sse)]
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def fake_stream(url, headers, body, connect_timeout=10.0, read_timeout=120.0, policy=None):
+        sent.append(dict(body))
+        yield replies.pop(0)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post_stream", fake_stream)
+    result = OpenAIAdapter(_cfg(["chat", "structured_json"])).complete(_req())
+    assert len(sent) == 2
+    assert "response_format" in sent[0] and "response_format" not in sent[1]
+    assert result.metadata["schema_enforced"] is False
+    assert result.metadata["schema_rejected_by_server"] is True
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+
+
+def test_the_heuristic():
+    assert oa._names_response_format(400, {"error": {"message": "bad RESPONSE_FORMAT"}})
+    assert oa._names_response_format(400, "json_schema: unsupported")
+    assert not oa._names_response_format(422, {"error": {"message": "response_format"}})
+    assert not oa._names_response_format(400, {"error": {"message": "context length exceeded"}})

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 / FR-8 (SDD D-7.2, D-7.3, D-8.0; sprint-257 Task 3.2, AC-3.2) — a local
+OpenAI-compatible hop end to end through `cheval.cmd_invoke`, the real loader and the real
+OpenAI adapter, against a stub server the test binds to 127.0.0.1 and stops.
+
+* The stub streams `reasoning_content` deltas, then a `<think>`-prefixed answer: the
+  answer printed is the JSON alone, and the MODELINV row records `thinking_stripped`,
+  `schema_enforced` (response_format carried for a `structured_json` entry),
+  `destination: {host, scheme, provider}`, `locality_mode` and `hop_locality: local`.
+* A stub that rejects `response_format` with HTTP 400: one retry without it,
+  `schema_enforced: false`, `schema_rejected_by_server: true`.
+* A prompt over the declared `context_window` refuses the hop with
+  `context_window exceeded (<n> > <limit>) for <alias>`, writes a MODELINV row with
+  `failure_class: context_window_refused`, and sends nothing to the server.
+* A hosted hop records `hop_locality: hosted` and its https destination.
+
+Every MODELINV payload captured here is validated against the shipped payload schema.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import json
+import shutil
+import sys
+import threading
+import types
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import jsonschema
+import pytest
+import yaml
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
+
+import cheval  # type: ignore[import-not-found]  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.config.loader import clear_config_cache, load_config  # noqa: E402
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+DEFAULTS = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml"
+PAYLOAD_SCHEMA = (REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "trajectory-schemas" / "model-events"
+                  / "model-invoke-complete.payload.schema.json")
+WIRE_SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"findings": {"type": "array"}}, "required": ["findings"]}
+
+
+def _payload_validator() -> jsonschema.Draft202012Validator:
+    schema = json.loads(PAYLOAD_SCHEMA.read_text())
+    # the error_class enum lives in a sibling schema behind a loa:// $ref; a string suffices here
+    schema["properties"]["models_failed"]["items"]["properties"]["error_class"] = {"type": "string"}
+    return jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema)
+
+
+VALIDATOR = _payload_validator()
+
+
+# --- the stub server -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Stub:
+    def __init__(self, mode: str = "stream-think") -> None:
+        stub = self
+        self.mode = mode
+        self.requests: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+        class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
+
+            def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
+                body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length) or b"{}")
+                stub.requests.append({"path": self.path, "headers": dict(self.headers), "body": body})
+                if stub.mode == "reject-schema" and "response_format" in body:
+                    payload = json.dumps({"object": "error", "message": "response_format json_schema unsupported",
+                                          "code": 400}).encode()
+                    self.send_response(400)
+                    self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
+                    self.end_headers()
+                    self.wfile.write(payload)
+                    return
+                events = [
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"role": "assistant", "reasoning_content": "Reading the diff. "}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"reasoning_content": "Nothing is wrong."}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": "<think>double-check</think>"}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": '{"findings": []}'}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}]},
+                    {"choices": [], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 7}},
+                ]
+                raw = b"".join(f"data: {json.dumps(dict(e, model='qwen3-coder-30b'))}\n\n".encode() for e in events)
+                raw += b"data: [DONE]\n\n"
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(raw)
+
+            def log_message(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+                pass
+

+        self.port = self.server.server_port
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+        self.thread.start()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self.server.shutdown()
+        self.server.server_close()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def stub():
+    s = _Stub()
+    yield s
+    s.stop()
+
+
+# --- harness -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _local_hounfour(port: int, *, context_window: int = 32768, caps: Optional[List[str]] = None,
+                    locality: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:

+        "providers": {
+            "local": {
+                "type": "openai_compat",
+                "endpoint": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1",
+                "keyless": True,
+                "allow_insecure_endpoint": "127.0.0.1",
+                "models": {
+                    "qwen3-coder-30b": {
+                        "endpoint_family": "chat", "auth_type": "http_api", "dispatch_group": "local",
+                        "capabilities": caps or ["chat", "structured_json"],
+                        "context_window": context_window, "max_output_tokens": 512,
+                        "streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 120},
+                        "pricing": {"input_per_mtok": 0, "output_per_mtok": 0},
+                    }
+                },
+            }
+        },
+        "aliases": {"local-reviewer": "local:qwen3-coder-30b"},
+        "feature_flags": {"metering": False},
+    }

+    return h
+
+
+def _merged(tmp_path: Path, hounfour: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    root = tmp_path / "proj"
+    (root / ".claude" / "defaults").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    shutil.copy(DEFAULTS, root / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml")
+    (root / ".loa.config.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump({"hounfour": hounfour}, sort_keys=False))
+    clear_config_cache()
+    merged, _ = load_config(project_root=str(root))

+
+
+def _args(prompt: str, *, model: str = "local-reviewer", json_schema: Optional[str] = None) -> Any:
+    a = types.SimpleNamespace()
+    a.agent = "flatline-reviewer"
+    a.role = None

+    monkeypatch.setattr(cheval, "_check_feature_flags", lambda *_a, **_kw: None)

+        monkeypatch.setenv(var, "http://127.0.0.1:1")   # a dead proxy: the local hop must ignore it

+    base._reset_http_client_detection_for_tests()

+def _invoke(merged: Dict[str, Any], args: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    captured: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+    def fake_emit(level, event, payload, *_a, **_kw):
+        captured.update(copy.deepcopy(payload))
+
+    with patch.object(cheval, "load_config", return_value=(merged, {})), \

+    body = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "__exit__"}

+    assert row["models_succeeded"] == ["local:qwen3-coder-30b"]
+    assert row["schema_enforced"] is True

+    assert row["locality_mode"] == "hosted"

+    s = _Stub(mode="reject-schema")
+    try:
+        schema_file = tmp_path / "adversarial-finding.wire.json"

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 (SDD D-7.3; sprint-257 Task 3.2, AC-3.2) — thinking traces from local
+reasoning models on the OpenAI paths.
+
+* Streamed `delta.reasoning_content` deltas count as progress for the recovery tracker
+  (they satisfy the first-token deadline) and never reach `content`; they land in
+  `thinking`.
+* Leading `<think>…</think>` blocks and an unterminated leading `<think>` are stripped
+  from the content before qualification on the streaming and the non-streaming path;
+  `thinking_stripped` is recorded in the result metadata (cheval copies it to MODELINV).
+* The model's `streaming_recovery` block reaches the stream parser.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterator, List
+
+import pytest
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from loa_cheval.providers import openai_adapter as oa  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers.openai_adapter import OpenAIAdapter  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers.openai_streaming import parse_openai_chat_stream, strip_thinking_blocks  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.streaming import StreamingRecoveryAbort  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.types import CompletionRequest, ModelConfig, ProviderConfig  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def _sse(*payloads: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[bytes]:
+    return [f"data: {json.dumps(p)}\n\n".encode() for p in payloads] + [b"data: [DONE]\n\n"]
+
+
+def _delta(**delta: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"choices": [{"delta": delta, "finish_reason": None}], "model": "m"}
+
+
+class _Clock:
+    """Advances `step` seconds on every read — each SSE event costs `step` seconds."""
+
+    def __init__(self, step: float):
+        self.t = 0.0
+        self.step = step
+
+    def __call__(self) -> float:
+        self.t += self.step
+        return self.t
+
+
+SLOW = {"streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 5}}
+
+
+def test_reasoning_deltas_keep_the_tracker_alive_and_never_reach_content():
+    chunks = _sse(
+        _delta(reasoning_content="Let me look at the diff. "),
+        _delta(reasoning_content="The loop is off by one. "),
+        _delta(reasoning_content="So the finding is the bound."),
+        _delta(content='{"findings": []}'),
+        {"choices": [{"delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}], "model": "m"},
+    )
+    # every event costs 3 s against a 5 s first-token deadline: content arrives at ~15 s
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", model_data=SLOW, now_provider=_Clock(3.0))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+    assert "off by one" in (result.thinking or "")
+    assert "Let me look" not in result.content
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True
+    assert result.metadata["streaming_recovery"]["config_applied"]["first_token_deadline_s"] == 5.0
+
+
+def test_control_without_reasoning_progress_the_deadline_fires():
+    chunks = _sse(
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},     # keep-alive-shaped frames: no content, no reasoning
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},
+        _delta(content='{"findings": []}'),
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(StreamingRecoveryAbort) as info:
+        parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", model_data=SLOW, now_provider=_Clock(3.0))
+    assert info.value.reason == "first_token_deadline"
+
+
+def test_reasoning_alias_key_and_no_empty_content_abort():
+    # 300 reasoning deltas exceed the 200-token empty-content window if they were fed as content
+    many = [_delta(reasoning="step ") for _ in range(300)]
+    chunks = _sse(*many, _delta(content="answer"))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", now_provider=_Clock(0.001))
+    assert result.content == "answer"
+    assert result.thinking.startswith("step step")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw, content, removed, stripped", [
+    ("<think>plan</think>\n{\"a\": 1}", '{"a": 1}', "plan", True),
+    ("  <THINK>one</THINK><think>two</think> answer", "answer", "one\ntwo", True),
+    ("<think>never closed, the budget ran out", "", "never closed, the budget ran out", True),
+    ('{"note": "the template uses <think> tags"}', '{"note": "the template uses <think> tags"}', "", False),
+    ("answer first <think>late</think>", "answer first <think>late</think>", "", False),
+    ("", "", "", False),
+], ids=["block", "two-blocks-case", "unterminated", "inside-answer-kept", "not-leading-kept", "empty"])
+def test_strip_thinking_blocks(raw, content, removed, stripped):
+    assert strip_thinking_blocks(raw) == (content, removed, stripped)
+
+
+def test_think_block_stripped_on_the_streaming_path():
+    chunks = _sse(_delta(content="<think>reasoning "), _delta(content="here</think>\n"),
+                  _delta(content='{"findings": [1]}'))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", now_provider=_Clock(0.01))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": [1]}'
+    assert result.thinking == "reasoning here"
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True
+
+
+def test_hosted_shaped_stream_records_thinking_stripped_false():
+    chunks = _sse(_delta(content='{"findings": []}'))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="openai", now_provider=_Clock(0.01))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+    assert result.thinking is None
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is False
+
+
+# --- through the adapter -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _adapter(**model_kwargs: Any) -> OpenAIAdapter:
+    return OpenAIAdapter(ProviderConfig(
+        name="local", type="openai_compat", endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", auth="", keyless=True,
+        allow_insecure_endpoint="127.0.0.1",
+        models={"m": ModelConfig(capabilities=["chat"], context_window=32768, endpoint_family="chat",
+                                 dispatch_group="local", **model_kwargs)},
+    ))
+
+
+def _req() -> CompletionRequest:
+    return CompletionRequest(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "review"}], model="m", max_tokens=64)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("message, thinking", [
+    ({"content": "<think>weighing it</think>{\"findings\": []}"}, "weighing it"),
+    ({"content": "{\"findings\": []}", "reasoning_content": "weighing it"}, "weighing it"),
+], ids=["inline-think", "reasoning_content"])
+def test_non_streaming_path_strips_and_records(monkeypatch, message, thinking):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", lambda *a, **k: (200, {"choices": [{"message": message}], "model": "m",
+                                                               "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1, "completion_tokens": 1}}))
+    result = _adapter().complete(_req())
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+    assert result.thinking == thinking
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True
+
+
+def test_adapter_passes_the_models_streaming_recovery_block(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", raising=False)
+    seen: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    real = oa.parse_openai_chat_stream
+
+    def spy(byte_iter: Iterator[bytes], **kwargs: Any):
+        seen.update(kwargs)
+        return real(byte_iter, **kwargs)
+
+    class _Resp:
+        status_code = 200
+
+        def iter_bytes(self):
+            return iter(_sse(_delta(reasoning_content="hm"), _delta(content="ok")))
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def fake_stream(*a: Any, **k: Any):
+        yield _Resp()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "parse_openai_chat_stream", spy)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post_stream", fake_stream)
+    result = _adapter(streaming_recovery={"first_token_deadline_s": 120}).complete(_req())
+    assert seen["model_data"] == {"streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 120}}
+    assert result.content == "ok" and result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True

+"""cycle-129 FR-7 / FR-8 (SDD D-7.2, D-7.3, D-8.0; sprint-257 Task 3.2, AC-3.2) — a local
+OpenAI-compatible hop end to end through `cheval.cmd_invoke`, the real loader and the real
+OpenAI adapter, against a stub server the test binds to 127.0.0.1 and stops.
+
+* The stub streams `reasoning_content` deltas, then a `<think>`-prefixed answer: the
+  answer printed is the JSON alone, and the MODELINV row records `thinking_stripped`,
+  `schema_enforced` (response_format carried for a `structured_json` entry),
+  `destination: {host, scheme, provider}`, `locality_mode` and `hop_locality: local`.
+* A stub that rejects `response_format` with HTTP 400: one retry without it,
+  `schema_enforced: false`, `schema_rejected_by_server: true`.
+* A prompt over the declared `context_window` refuses the hop with
+  `context_window exceeded (<n> > <limit>) for <alias>`, writes a MODELINV row with
+  `failure_class: context_window_refused`, and sends nothing to the server.
+* A hosted hop records `hop_locality: hosted` and its https destination.
+
+Every MODELINV payload captured here is validated against the shipped payload schema.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import json
+import shutil
+import sys
+import threading
+import types
+from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, HTTPServer
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import jsonschema
+import pytest
+import yaml
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))
+
+import cheval  # type: ignore[import-not-found]  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.config.loader import clear_config_cache, load_config  # noqa: E402
+
+REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
+DEFAULTS = REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml"
+PAYLOAD_SCHEMA = (REPO_ROOT / ".claude" / "data" / "trajectory-schemas" / "model-events"
+                  / "model-invoke-complete.payload.schema.json")
+WIRE_SCHEMA = {"type": "object", "properties": {"findings": {"type": "array"}}, "required": ["findings"]}
+
+
+def _payload_validator() -> jsonschema.Draft202012Validator:
+    schema = json.loads(PAYLOAD_SCHEMA.read_text())
+    # the error_class enum lives in a sibling schema behind a loa:// $ref; a string suffices here
+    schema["properties"]["models_failed"]["items"]["properties"]["error_class"] = {"type": "string"}
+    return jsonschema.Draft202012Validator(schema)
+
+
+VALIDATOR = _payload_validator()
+
+
+# --- the stub server -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _Stub:
+    def __init__(self, mode: str = "stream-think") -> None:
+        stub = self
+        self.mode = mode
+        self.requests: List[Dict[str, Any]] = []
+
+        class H(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+            protocol_version = "HTTP/1.1"
+
+            def do_POST(self) -> None:  # noqa: N802
+                length = int(self.headers.get("Content-Length") or 0)
+                body = json.loads(self.rfile.read(length) or b"{}")
+                stub.requests.append({"path": self.path, "headers": dict(self.headers), "body": body})
+                if stub.mode == "reject-schema" and "response_format" in body:
+                    payload = json.dumps({"object": "error", "message": "response_format json_schema unsupported",
+                                          "code": 400}).encode()
+                    self.send_response(400)
+                    self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
+                    self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(payload)))
+                    self.end_headers()
+                    self.wfile.write(payload)
+                    return
+                events = [
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"role": "assistant", "reasoning_content": "Reading the diff. "}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"reasoning_content": "Nothing is wrong."}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": "<think>double-check</think>"}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {"content": '{"findings": []}'}}]},
+                    {"choices": [{"delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}]},
+                    {"choices": [], "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 7}},
+                ]
+                raw = b"".join(f"data: {json.dumps(dict(e, model='qwen3-coder-30b'))}\n\n".encode() for e in events)
+                raw += b"data: [DONE]\n\n"
+                self.send_response(200)
+                self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
+                self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(raw)))
+                self.end_headers()
+                self.wfile.write(raw)
+
+            def log_message(self, *args: Any) -> None:
+                pass
+
+        self.server = HTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), H)
+        self.port = self.server.server_port
+        self.thread = threading.Thread(target=self.server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+        self.thread.start()
+
+    def stop(self) -> None:
+        self.server.shutdown()
+        self.server.server_close()
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def stub():
+    s = _Stub()
+    yield s
+    s.stop()
+
+
+# --- harness -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _local_hounfour(port: int, *, context_window: int = 32768, caps: Optional[List[str]] = None,
+                    locality: Optional[str] = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    h: Dict[str, Any] = {
+        "providers": {
+            "local": {
+                "type": "openai_compat",
+                "endpoint": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/v1",
+                "keyless": True,
+                "allow_insecure_endpoint": "127.0.0.1",
+                "models": {
+                    "qwen3-coder-30b": {
+                        "endpoint_family": "chat", "auth_type": "http_api", "dispatch_group": "local",
+                        "capabilities": caps or ["chat", "structured_json"],
+                        "context_window": context_window, "max_output_tokens": 512,
+                        "streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 120},
+                        "pricing": {"input_per_mtok": 0, "output_per_mtok": 0},
+                    }
+                },
+            }
+        },
+        "aliases": {"local-reviewer": "local:qwen3-coder-30b"},
+        "feature_flags": {"metering": False},
+    }
+    if locality:
+        h["locality"] = locality
+    return h
+
+
+def _merged(tmp_path: Path, hounfour: Dict[str, Any]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    root = tmp_path / "proj"
+    (root / ".claude" / "defaults").mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    shutil.copy(DEFAULTS, root / ".claude" / "defaults" / "model-config.yaml")
+    (root / ".loa.config.yaml").write_text(yaml.safe_dump({"hounfour": hounfour}, sort_keys=False))
+    clear_config_cache()
+    merged, _ = load_config(project_root=str(root))
+    return merged
+
+
+def _args(prompt: str, *, model: str = "local-reviewer", json_schema: Optional[str] = None) -> Any:
+    a = types.SimpleNamespace()
+    a.agent = "flatline-reviewer"
+    a.role = None
+    a.skill = None
+    a.sprint_kind = None
+    a.input = None
+    a.prompt = prompt
+    a.system = None
+    a.model = model
+    a.max_tokens = 256
+    a.output_format = "text"
+    a.json_errors = True
+    a.timeout = 30
+    a.include_thinking = False
+    a.async_mode = False
+    a.poll_id = None
+    a.cancel_id = None
+    a.dry_run = False
+    a.print_config = False
+    a.validate_bindings = False
+    a.mock_fixture_dir = None
+    a.max_input_tokens = None
+    a.json_schema = json_schema
+    a.effort = None

+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _quiet(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cheval, "_load_persona", lambda *_a, **_kw: None)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cheval, "_load_persona_parts", lambda *_a, **_kw: (None, None))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cheval, "_check_feature_flags", lambda *_a, **_kw: None)
+    for var in ("HTTP_PROXY", "HTTPS_PROXY", "ALL_PROXY", "http_proxy", "https_proxy", "all_proxy"):
+        monkeypatch.setenv(var, "http://127.0.0.1:1")   # a dead proxy: the local hop must ignore it
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", raising=False)
+    from loa_cheval.providers import base
+    base._reset_http_client_detection_for_tests()

+
+def _invoke(merged: Dict[str, Any], args: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    captured: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+
+    def fake_emit(level, event, payload, *_a, **_kw):
+        captured.update(copy.deepcopy(payload))
+
+    with patch.object(cheval, "load_config", return_value=(merged, {})), \
+         patch("loa_cheval.audit_envelope.audit_emit", fake_emit), \
+         patch("loa_cheval.audit.modelinv.redact_payload_strings", side_effect=lambda x: x), \
+         patch("loa_cheval.audit.modelinv.assert_no_secret_shapes_remain"):

+
+
+def _assert_schema_valid(payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+    body = {k: v for k, v in payload.items() if k != "__exit__"}
+    errors = sorted(VALIDATOR.iter_errors(body), key=lambda e: list(e.path))
+    assert not errors, [f"{list(e.path)}: {e.message}" for e in errors]

+  `thinking`.
+* Leading `<think>…</think>` blocks and an unterminated leading `<think>` are stripped
+  from the content before qualification on the streaming and the non-streaming path;
+  `thinking_stripped` is recorded in the result metadata (cheval copies it to MODELINV).
+* The model's `streaming_recovery` block reaches the stream parser.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import sys
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import Any, Dict, Iterator, List
+
+import pytest
+
+sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
+
+from loa_cheval.providers import openai_adapter as oa  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers.openai_adapter import OpenAIAdapter  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.providers.openai_streaming import parse_openai_chat_stream, strip_thinking_blocks  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.streaming import StreamingRecoveryAbort  # noqa: E402
+from loa_cheval.types import CompletionRequest, ModelConfig, ProviderConfig  # noqa: E402
+
+
+def _sse(*payloads: Dict[str, Any]) -> List[bytes]:
+    return [f"data: {json.dumps(p)}\n\n".encode() for p in payloads] + [b"data: [DONE]\n\n"]
+
+
+def _delta(**delta: Any) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {"choices": [{"delta": delta, "finish_reason": None}], "model": "m"}
+
+
+class _Clock:
+    """Advances `step` seconds on every read — each SSE event costs `step` seconds."""
+
+    def __init__(self, step: float):
+        self.t = 0.0
+        self.step = step
+
+    def __call__(self) -> float:
+        self.t += self.step
+        return self.t
+
+
+SLOW = {"streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 5}}
+
+
+def test_reasoning_deltas_keep_the_tracker_alive_and_never_reach_content():
+    chunks = _sse(
+        _delta(reasoning_content="Let me look at the diff. "),
+        _delta(reasoning_content="The loop is off by one. "),
+        _delta(reasoning_content="So the finding is the bound."),
+        _delta(content='{"findings": []}'),
+        {"choices": [{"delta": {}, "finish_reason": "stop"}], "model": "m"},
+    )
+    # every event costs 3 s against a 5 s first-token deadline: content arrives at ~15 s
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", model_data=SLOW, now_provider=_Clock(3.0))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+    assert "off by one" in (result.thinking or "")
+    assert "Let me look" not in result.content
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True
+    assert result.metadata["streaming_recovery"]["config_applied"]["first_token_deadline_s"] == 5.0
+
+
+def test_control_without_reasoning_progress_the_deadline_fires():
+    chunks = _sse(
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},     # keep-alive-shaped frames: no content, no reasoning
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},
+        {"choices": [], "model": "m"},
+        _delta(content='{"findings": []}'),
+    )
+    with pytest.raises(StreamingRecoveryAbort) as info:
+        parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", model_data=SLOW, now_provider=_Clock(3.0))
+    assert info.value.reason == "first_token_deadline"
+
+
+def test_reasoning_alias_key_and_no_empty_content_abort():
+    # 300 reasoning deltas exceed the 200-token empty-content window if they were fed as content
+    many = [_delta(reasoning="step ") for _ in range(300)]
+    chunks = _sse(*many, _delta(content="answer"))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", now_provider=_Clock(0.001))
+    assert result.content == "answer"
+    assert result.thinking.startswith("step step")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("raw, content, removed, stripped", [
+    ("<think>plan</think>\n{\"a\": 1}", '{"a": 1}', "plan", True),
+    ("  <THINK>one</THINK><think>two</think> answer", "answer", "one\ntwo", True),
+    ("<think>never closed, the budget ran out", "", "never closed, the budget ran out", True),
+    ('{"note": "the template uses <think> tags"}', '{"note": "the template uses <think> tags"}', "", False),
+    ("answer first <think>late</think>", "answer first <think>late</think>", "", False),
+    ("", "", "", False),
+], ids=["block", "two-blocks-case", "unterminated", "inside-answer-kept", "not-leading-kept", "empty"])
+def test_strip_thinking_blocks(raw, content, removed, stripped):
+    assert strip_thinking_blocks(raw) == (content, removed, stripped)
+
+
+def test_think_block_stripped_on_the_streaming_path():
+    chunks = _sse(_delta(content="<think>reasoning "), _delta(content="here</think>\n"),
+                  _delta(content='{"findings": [1]}'))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="local", now_provider=_Clock(0.01))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": [1]}'
+    assert result.thinking == "reasoning here"
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True
+
+
+def test_hosted_shaped_stream_records_thinking_stripped_false():
+    chunks = _sse(_delta(content='{"findings": []}'))
+    result = parse_openai_chat_stream(iter(chunks), provider="openai", now_provider=_Clock(0.01))
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+    assert result.thinking is None
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is False
+
+
+# --- through the adapter -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def _adapter(**model_kwargs: Any) -> OpenAIAdapter:
+    return OpenAIAdapter(ProviderConfig(
+        name="local", type="openai_compat", endpoint="http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1", auth="", keyless=True,
+        allow_insecure_endpoint="127.0.0.1",
+        models={"m": ModelConfig(capabilities=["chat"], context_window=32768, endpoint_family="chat",
+                                 dispatch_group="local", **model_kwargs)},
+    ))
+
+
+def _req() -> CompletionRequest:
+    return CompletionRequest(messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "review"}], model="m", max_tokens=64)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("message, thinking", [
+    ({"content": "<think>weighing it</think>{\"findings\": []}"}, "weighing it"),
+    ({"content": "{\"findings\": []}", "reasoning_content": "weighing it"}, "weighing it"),
+], ids=["inline-think", "reasoning_content"])
+def test_non_streaming_path_strips_and_records(monkeypatch, message, thinking):
+    monkeypatch.setenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", "1")
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post", lambda *a, **k: (200, {"choices": [{"message": message}], "model": "m",
+                                                               "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1, "completion_tokens": 1}}))
+    result = _adapter().complete(_req())
+    assert result.content == '{"findings": []}'
+    assert result.thinking == thinking
+    assert result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True
+
+
+def test_adapter_passes_the_models_streaming_recovery_block(monkeypatch):
+    monkeypatch.delenv("LOA_CHEVAL_DISABLE_STREAMING", raising=False)
+    seen: Dict[str, Any] = {}
+    real = oa.parse_openai_chat_stream
+
+    def spy(byte_iter: Iterator[bytes], **kwargs: Any):
+        seen.update(kwargs)
+        return real(byte_iter, **kwargs)
+
+    class _Resp:
+        status_code = 200
+
+        def iter_bytes(self):
+            return iter(_sse(_delta(reasoning_content="hm"), _delta(content="ok")))
+
+    @contextmanager
+    def fake_stream(*a: Any, **k: Any):
+        yield _Resp()
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "parse_openai_chat_stream", spy)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(oa, "http_post_stream", fake_stream)
+    result = _adapter(streaming_recovery={"first_token_deadline_s": 120}).complete(_req())
+    assert seen["model_data"] == {"streaming_recovery": {"first_token_deadline_s": 120}}
+    assert result.content == "ok" and result.metadata["thinking_stripped"] is True

+# --- the budget gate (D-7.4, D-7.6): every planned voice at its catalog price ------------------------------------------

+_ADV_BUDGET_VOICES="[]"

+  # each voice: input tokens × input rate + 2000 output tokens × output rate (micro-USD per Mtok → cents: ÷ 10^10, each term

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""hop-locality.py — classify model hops as local or hosted for `hounfour.locality: local_voices` (cycle-129 FR-8,
+SDD D-8.0 / D-8.1, DEC-0146).
+
+    python3 -I hop-locality.py --catalog <model-config.yaml> --config <.loa.config.yaml> -- <hop>...
+
+One tab-separated line per hop, in the order given:
+
+    <hop> TAB <provider|unknown> TAB <local|hosted> TAB <reason>
+
+A hop is `local` only when ALL of these hold in the merged view (the System Zone catalog overlaid with the project
+config's `hounfour.providers` / `hounfour.aliases`, the two layers cheval merges):
+  * it resolves (a `provider:id` pin, an alias chain, or a bare id that exactly one provider declares) to a model entry
+    that exists;
+  * that model entry, or its provider block, says `dispatch_group: local` (the canonical key, D-8.0);
+  * every hop on the entry's own `fallback_chain` is local by the same rule — cheval walks that chain inside one call,
+    so a local entry that falls back to a hosted one would leave the declared providers without the planner seeing it.
+Everything else is `hosted`: an unresolved hop, an unreadable config, a headless CLI hop (its dispatch group is the
+provider family's), the native session. Fail closed — a hop is never called local because it could not be read.
+
+This file reads declarations only: it never dispatches, never reads credentials and never imports the cheval package
+(run under `-I`, so neither the cwd nor PYTHONPATH reaches sys.path). The request-time rules for a local hop (IP-literal
+or localhost endpoint, no DNS, redirects refused, proxy env ignored, destination logged) are cheval's.
+"""
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import argparse
+import sys
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
+
+MAX_DEPTH = 10
+
+
+def _merge(base: Any, overlay: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(base, dict) and isinstance(overlay, dict):
+        out = dict(base)
+        for key, value in overlay.items():
+            out[key] = _merge(base.get(key), value) if key in base else value
+        return out
+    return overlay
+
+
+def load_merged(catalog_path: str, config_path: Optional[str]) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    import yaml
+
+    with open(catalog_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+        catalog = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
+    if not isinstance(catalog, dict):
+        raise ValueError("catalog is not a mapping")
+    merged: Dict[str, Any] = {k: (catalog.get(k) if isinstance(catalog.get(k), dict) else {})
+                              for k in ("providers", "aliases", "backward_compat_aliases")}
+    if config_path:
+        try:
+            with open(config_path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
+                project = yaml.safe_load(fh) or {}
+        except FileNotFoundError:
+            project = {}
+        if not isinstance(project, dict):
+            raise ValueError("project config is not a mapping")
+        hounfour = project.get("hounfour")
+        if isinstance(hounfour, dict):
+            for key in ("providers", "aliases"):
+                if isinstance(hounfour.get(key), dict):
+                    merged[key] = _merge(merged.get(key) or {}, hounfour[key])
+    return merged
+
+
+def _alias_target(name: str, merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[str]:
+    for table in ("aliases", "backward_compat_aliases"):
+        target = (merged.get(table) or {}).get(name)
+        if isinstance(target, dict):
+            target = target.get("target") or target.get("model")
+        if isinstance(target, str) and target.strip():
+            return target.strip()
+    return None
+
+
+def resolve(hop: str, merged: Dict[str, Any]) -> Optional[Tuple[str, str]]:
+    name = (hop or "").strip()
+    if not name:
+        return None
+    current, seen = name, set()
+    for _ in range(MAX_DEPTH):
+        if ":" in current:
+            provider, _, model = current.partition(":")
+            return (provider, model) if provider and model else None
+        target = _alias_target(current, merged)
+        if not target:
+            break
+        if target in seen:
+            return None
+        seen.add(current)
+        current = target
+    if ":" in current:
+        provider, _, model = current.partition(":")
+        return (provider, model) if provider and model else None
+    providers = merged.get("providers") or {}
+    matches = [p for p, block in providers.items()
+               if isinstance(block, dict) and isinstance(block.get("models"), dict) and current in block["models"]]
+    return (matches[0], current) if len(matches) == 1 else None
+
+
+def classify(hop: str, merged: Dict[str, Any], _depth: int = 0, _seen: Optional[set] = None) -> Tuple[str, str, str]:
+    """(provider, locality, reason) for one hop."""
+    seen = set(_seen or ())
+    target = resolve(hop, merged)
+    if target is None:
+        return "unknown", "hosted", "unresolved"
+    provider, model = target
+    block = (merged.get("providers") or {}).get(provider)
+    if not isinstance(block, dict):
+        return provider, "hosted", "provider_not_declared"
+    entry = (block.get("models") or {}).get(model) if isinstance(block.get("models"), dict) else None
+    if not isinstance(entry, dict):
+        return provider, "hosted", "model_not_declared"
+    group = entry.get("dispatch_group") or block.get("dispatch_group") or ""
+    if group != "local":
+        return provider, "hosted", f"dispatch_group={group or 'unset'}"
+    key = f"{provider}:{model}"
+    if key in seen:
+        return provider, "local", "dispatch_group=local"
+    seen.add(key)
+    chain = entry.get("fallback_chain") or []
+    if not isinstance(chain, list):
+        return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_unreadable"
+    if _depth >= MAX_DEPTH:
+        return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_too_deep"
+    for nxt in chain:
+        if not isinstance(nxt, str):
+            return provider, "hosted", "fallback_chain_unreadable"
+        p2, loc, _ = classify(nxt, merged, _depth + 1, seen)
+        if loc != "local":
+            return provider, "hosted", f"fallback_chain_reaches_hosted:{nxt}({p2})"
+    return provider, "local", "dispatch_group=local"
+
+
+def _clean(text: str) -> str:
+    return "".join(c if c.isprintable() and c not in "\t" else "_" for c in text)[:128]
+
+
+def main(argv: Optional[List[str]] = None) -> int:
+    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.split("\n")[0])
+    ap.add_argument("--catalog", required=True)
+    ap.add_argument("--config", default="")
+    ap.add_argument("hops", nargs="*")
+    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
+    try:
+        merged = load_merged(args.catalog, args.config or None)
+        err = ""
+    except Exception as exc:  # noqa: BLE001 — fail closed: every hop hosted, the reason said once
+        merged, err = None, f"{type(exc).__name__}"
+        print(f"hop-locality: the merged config could not be read ({err}) — every hop is hosted", file=sys.stderr)
+    for hop in args.hops:
+        if merged is None:
+            print(f"{_clean(hop)}\tunknown\thosted\tconfig_unreadable")
+            continue
+        provider, loc, reason = classify(hop, merged)
+        print(f"{_clean(hop)}\t{_clean(provider)}\t{loc}\t{_clean(reason)}")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
